title: Loosening of planning rules in England to allow more new homes near stations

paragraphs.en: Thousands more homes could be built within 10 minutes of transport hubs, including on green belt sites, under a loosening of planning policy announced by Angela Rayner on Monday.
paragraphs.zh: 根据安吉拉·雷纳周一宣布放宽的规划政策，更多数千套住房可在交通枢纽10分钟范围内建成，包括在绿化带地块上。

paragraphs.en: The housing secretary will set out changes to national planning guidance for England that will include an order for councils to have a “default yes” approach to housing developments that are within a reasonable walking distance of well-connected train and tram stations.
paragraphs.zh: 住房大臣将公布英格兰国家规划指南的修订内容，其中包括要求地方议会对位于交通便利的火车站和电车站合理步行距离内的住宅开发项目采取“默认同意”的做法。

paragraphs.en: If a proposed development is on green belt land, then the government’s “golden rules” state that they must have higher levels of affordable housing, new or improved green spaces, and be supported by the right infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 如果拟议的开发项目位于绿化带土地上，那么根据政府的“黄金法则”，这些项目必须提供更高比例的可负担住房、新建或改善绿地，并配备适当的基础设施。

paragraphs.en: The approach was put out to consultation under Rayner’s predecessor , Steve Reed, but the guidance will be confirmed as part of the new national planning policy framework (NPPF) this week.
paragraphs.zh: 这一做法曾在雷纳的前任史蒂夫·里德任内被征求意见，但本周该指南将作为新的国家规划政策框架（NPPF）的一部分得到确认。

paragraphs.en: Rayner is billing the changes as part of the biggest rewrite of planning rules in more than a decade as the government moves towards its target of 1.5m new homes being built by the end of this parliament. The government is about a quarter of the way to its target, two years into a five-year parliament.
paragraphs.zh: 雷纳将此次修订称为十多年来最大规模的规划规则改写的一部分，政府正朝着在本届议会任期结束前建成150万套新住房的目标迈进。目前五年任期已过去两年，政府仅完成了目标的大约四分之一。

paragraphs.en: There will also be new minimum expectations for how much housing should be built in these areas.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，还将为这些地区应建设多少住房设定新的最低期望值。

paragraphs.en: Rayner said on Sunday it would help address the fact that “too many people are being priced out of the communities where they want to live and work”.
paragraphs.zh: 雷纳周日表示，这将有助于解决“太多人因房价过高而被排除在他们想要生活和工作的社区之外”的问题。

paragraphs.en: “By unlocking thousands of homes around well-connected transport hubs, we’re helping people live closer to work, school and the services they rely on, while backing local businesses and driving growth in our communities,” she said. “That’s how we’ll tackle the housing crisis and raise living standards for people in every corner of the country.”
paragraphs.zh: 她说：“通过解锁交通便利枢纽周边的数千套住房，我们正在帮助人们住得更靠近工作地点、学校和所依赖的服务，同时支持本地企业，推动社区增长。这就是我们解决住房危机、提高全国各地人民生活水平的方式。”
